title: Emergency Meeting
blurb: Everything stops, everybody explains themselves, and somebody is about to be ejected on very thin evidence. Among Us gave the internet a formal procedure for accusation, and this alarm is what opens proceedings — InnerSloth's 2018 game found its enormous audience in 2020, when a great many people had unexpected free time and a great deal of suspicion. The sound now works perfectly outside the game. Play it when the group chat requires urgent moderation, or when somebody genuinely has to account for their movements.
origin: The emergency meeting alarm from Among Us (InnerSloth).
